visual_motion_analysis.base_reference: The same attacker-body template matches at zero offset in base frames 032-035. These are separate capture windows and support visual context only; they do not phase-lock the two ROMs.
visual_motion_analysis.interpretation: A stable-pose match and fixed-HUD comparison demonstrate visible screen-space movement in the running both ROM. The game combines Stage 3 impact shake with legacy vertical EnvShake, so this trace does not identify their individual contributions or approve shake quality.
